why: Found by I122 while writing its prereg, before any build commit or measured run (Q67: a test is never dropped from its CI job; amended to name the mode it was written for). P6 says that without the opt-ins every output is as before, so no protocol before I117 names go.ops. It globbed every spec/*/lib/*.json except i117_run.json, so it also judges later keys: I122's protocol (spec/M6/lib/i122_run.json, its base plus go.loops) carries I117's go.ops "typed" by construction and would fail it, although no earlier protocol changed. The amended check also skips the protocols of I117 and later keys (an iteration field I117 or above), as I115 amended I112's test_p1 and I117 amended I115's test_p6. Every earlier protocol is still checked, and the claim is unchanged.
